prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single, objectively “best” lawyer — the right one depends on your case (injuries, fault issues, amount of damages), whether you want to take a case to trial, and whether you connect with the lawyer. I can help you find a great fit. To get started, tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and a brief summary of the crash and injuries. Meanwhile, here are practical steps and how to evaluate candidates:

Immediate steps (if you haven’t already)
- Get medical attention and follow the doctor’s orders (medical records are key evidence).
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles, scene, injuries, police report, contact info for witnesses.
- Don’t give recorded statements to the other party’s insurer or sign releases without a lawyer.
- Be aware: Texas statute of limitations for most car wreck injury claims is 2 years from the crash date.

Where to look for reputable Houston personal injury attorneys
- Texas State Bar lawyer search (to confirm license and discipline record).
- Independent rating sites: Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Avvo, and Best Lawyers.
- Local referrals: Ask friends/family or other attorneys (like your family lawyer) for referrals.
- Check firm websites for recent verdicts/settlements and trial experience in car crash cases.

How to choose — checklist of what to compare
- Experience: How many car wreck/personal injury cases do they handle? Do they try cases or mostly settle?
- Track record: Documented settlements/verdicts for similar injuries.
- Resources: Do they have investigators, medical experts, and litigation staff for big cases?
- Communication: Who will handle your case day-to-day? How quickly do they return calls/texts?
- Fees: Most work on contingency (no fee unless you win). Ask their percentage and whether costs are advanced.
- Client reviews and disciplinary history.

Questions to ask in the free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What was the outcome?
- Who will work on my case and how will I communicate with them?
- What is your contingency fee and what costs would be deducted from my recovery?
- Do you take cases to trial? If so, how many trials have you had in the last 3–5 years?
- Can you provide references from recent clients?

If you want, give me your ZIP or neighborhood and a short description of the accident and injuries and I’ll pull together a short list of well-rated Houston personal injury lawyers who handle car wrecks and who match the type of case you have.
